title: The Hollow of the Glass Steppe
author: Ansel Thornbury
blurb: Jonah Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
